reviews.text: Did a really nice job on our guest room and guest room closet. Patched our deteriorating plaster walls, painted ceilings and all trim, and wallpapered. Swapped out a ceiling fan and wall sockets as well. Worked at the times our schedules would allow, and was easy to reach when we had questions. Very easy going and friendly. Would highly recommend.

As a single homeowner, it can be overwhelming to find a reliable and fairly priced handyman. Cosa was professional, efficient, and made me feel well taken care of. He was accommodating with scheduling and pricing. I will definitely be using his services in the future. If you're in the Clifton area and looking for a reliable handyman, he's your guy.
He was wonderful and did an amazing job! Great price for exceptional work. Also we quick and easy to book. Cant wait to use them for other projects.
